window_start_basis: environment_protocol.json filesystem modification timestamp at inspection
filter: Parse timestamped events; retain event names Sleep, Wake, DarkWake, WakeTime, or SleepService inside the inclusive UTC window.
interpretation: No matching sleep/wake event was observed in the available local power log during this bounded window, which contains the entire saved replay. This negative observation is not a universal proof of uninterrupted wakefulness.
privacy: Only this filtered result is retained; unrelated host log details were neither included in the report nor retained in a new file.
caffeinate_limit: The configured caffeinate -i prevents idle sleep, not clamshell/explicit sleep or shutdown.
